title: Customer Care Knowledge Article — Ending Net Energy Metering When Electric Service Stops at the Address
content:
**Scope.** Under Net Energy Metering, this rule governs the customer's own decision to end an operating net metering agreement because they are stopping electric service at the address and no transfer to a buyer applies, under a rider whose termination disposition is cash out.

**Outside this rule.** A move-out whose final bill is dated in the agreement's true-up month is outside this rule. An agreement under a rider whose termination disposition is forfeit is outside this rule; its bank is forfeited at termination as the base rule provides.

**When the settlement is fixed.** The move-out settlement is not fixed until every billing period billed on the hosting service agreement since permission to operate has an export credit in the net metering history. While any such billing period has no export credit in the history, the move-out settlement is not fixed.

**Settlement.** At a move-out termination under a rider whose termination disposition is cash out, the move-out payout is paid by check and the rest of the bank is surrendered, so the bank stands at zero once the agreement is terminated. This rule settles a move-out payout of at least the rider's check minimum; a smaller move-out payout is credited to the service agreement as the base rule provides.

## Coverage at a glance

| Situation | Under this rule |
|---|---|
| Customer stops electric service at the address, no transfer to a buyer, operating agreement, cash-out termination disposition, final bill not dated in the true-up month | Yes |
| Final bill dated in the agreement's true-up month | No |
| Rider whose termination disposition is forfeit | No; the bank is forfeited at termination |
| Move-out payout below the rider's check minimum | No; credited to the service agreement |

## Ending the agreement — `end_net_metering_at_move_out_41499158`

**Capability.** The customer ends their operating net metering agreement: the agreement becomes terminated as of the day the tool is run, the move-out payout is recorded as a termination settlement paid by check, any part of the bank not paid is recorded as surrendered at termination, and the agreement's banked credit becomes 0.00. Afterwards the agreement shows terminated status and the history shows the check payout, and the surrendered amount when it is above zero.

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own tool. The representative unlocks it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it with `call_user_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `nem_agreement_id` | Reference number of the customer's net metering agreement, as given to the customer by the representative from the agreement lookup | Identifier |
| `payout_usd` | Move-out payout to be sent by check, exactly as the representative states it | USD, positive decimal with 2 decimal places |
| `surrendered_usd` | Part of the bank that is not paid and is surrendered, exactly as the representative states it | USD, decimal with 2 decimal places; 0.00 when nothing is surrendered |

**Return.** On success the receipt carries `status` "terminated"; `nem_agreement_id`; `termination_date`, the day's date in YYYY-MM-DD; `payout_reference`, the reference number of the check payout entry; `payout_amount` and `surrendered_amount` in USD with 2 decimals; and `credit_bank_balance`, 0.00 after settlement.
